article.headline: Furman secures 78-71 win over Radford
article.description: — Luka Toews’ 18 points helped Furman defeat Radford 78-71 on Wednesday.
article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Luka Toews’ 18 points helped Furman defeat Radford 78-71 on Wednesday. Toews also contributed seven rebounds and eight assists for the Paladins (5-1). Marcus Kell scored 17 points while going 5 of 14 from the floor, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range, and 4 for 7 from the line, and added six rebounds. Tom House shot 2 for 6 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Mathieu Grujicic finished with 21 points for the Highlanders (1-4). Frederik Erichsen added 12 points and seven rebounds for Radford. Tristan Gross also had 11 points. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. Furman hosts Clinton College and Radfordsquares off against Chattanooga on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
